findings.violation: Text color #999999 on a light background has insufficient contrast for readability.
findings.fix: Change text color to #595959 or darker to meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 contrast ratio).

findings.location: Form field for route selection, line near id="topic"
findings.violation: The label's for attribute references "topic-alt" but the select element has id="topic", causing the label not to associate with the input.
findings.fix: Change the select element id to "topic-alt" or change the label's for attribute to "topic".

findings.evidence: <input id="promo" type="text" aria-invalid="true"> followed by <span class="error-text">
findings.violation: The input is marked invalid with aria-invalid but does not reference the error message with aria-describedby, breaking the connection for screen readers.
findings.fix: Add aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" to the input element to link it to the error message.

findings.violation: Fixed height of 60px with overflow hidden truncates the content inside, making it potentially unreadable or inaccessible.
findings.fix: Remove the fixed height and overflow hidden, or increase the height sufficiently to display all content without clipping.

findings.violation: Fixed width of 960px prevents responsive behavior on smaller screens and can cause content to be cut off on mobile devices.
findings.fix: Replace fixed width with max-width:960px or use percentage-based widths to allow responsive scaling.

findings.violation: A div is repurposed as a button using role="button", but it may lack proper JavaScript event handlers for keyboard navigation and click handling.
findings.fix: Replace the div with a native <button> element, or ensure comprehensive keyboard and click event handlers are implemented.

findings.violation: Wizard steps should use semantic ordered list structure (ol/li) but instead use div elements, reducing semantic clarity and accessibility.
findings.fix: Restructure using <ol><li> or <nav><ol><li> for proper semantic meaning.

findings.location: Link in paragraph within Weekend service section
findings.violation: Link text "read the accessibility improvements list" is generic and does not clearly indicate what page the link leads to within its context.
findings.fix: Change link text to something more descriptive like "view the complete list of accessibility improvements" or add title attribute for clarity.

findings.location: Phone number field label in form
findings.violation: The labels reference form field ids that may not correctly match their associated inputs.
findings.fix: Verify all label for attributes precisely match their corresponding input id attributes throughout the form.

findings.violation: The submit button lacks a descriptive context about what form is being submitted (is it for fare adjustment, service issue report, etc.).
findings.fix: Add aria-label or change button text to specify the action, e.g., "Submit service request" or "Request fare adjustment".
